_comment: S22 P252 — the block atlas cannot see 1.12.2's plural texture directories.
Blockbuster 2.7.2 ships its block/item sprites under the pre-flattening
assets/blockbuster/textures/blocks/ and .../textures/items/, and the port
keeps that layout verbatim (1.12.2 is the behaviour bar, and a 2.7.2-era
resource pack overriding a chroma colour puts its PNG at exactly those
paths). 1.20.4 stitches the block atlas from minecraft:atlases/blocks.json,
whose directory sources are the singular block/ and item/ only, so every
one of our sprites resolved to the missing-texture checkerboard.
AtlasLoader.of() reads this identifier with ResourceManager.getAllResources
and addAll()s every pack's source list, so this file APPENDS to vanilla's
-- it does not replace it. (Fabric API's NamespaceResourceManagerMixin ->
GroupResourcePack.appendResources makes that true across mods too, so two
mods shipping this path both contribute.)
'single' sources, not two 'directory' ones, on purpose: a directory source
scans EVERY namespace for textures/blocks/**.png, which would sweep any
1.12.2-era vanilla resource pack the user still has installed into the
block atlas. 1.12.2 itself registered exactly the sprites models asked for
(TextureMap.registerSprite from ModelBakery) and never scanned a directory,
so an explicit list is also the closer parity. BlockAtlasSourcesTest keeps
this list and the shipped PNGs in exact correspondence.
